title: Carrier admin console redesign
story: As a carrier admin I want a settings console that looks like a real enterprise admin product so that configuring the platform feels safe and obvious
acceptance: Uses fx-app-shell, the design system and <fx-demo-bar>; old dev form gone when the bar is present

Left section navigation (branding, intake questions, routing and fast-track rules, regulatory timers, integrations and webhooks, AI settings, KPIs); each section as cards with labelled forms, help text, and a clear save bar showing unsaved changes and a diff preview before saving; KPI dashboard with stat tiles
Existing admin behaviour (versioned PUT /config with If-Match, webhook management) still works; tests/ui/admin.test.mjs and tests/unit/web/admin/ updated and passing; full npm test no new failures
Screenshots: docs/design/screens/admin-branding, -rules, -kpis at 1440x900; reviewer opens them
brief: Compare with docs/design/before/admin*.png. Do not edit src/web/shared/.
